nodes.name: entrance
nodes.label: entrance
nodes.description: Realman welcomes visitors and introduces the lab tour. Serves as both the entry and exit point for the lab. Starting location for navigating to major chambers and demo areas.

nodes.name: seminar_room
nodes.label: seminar room
nodes.description: Theatre-style seating arranged for group sessions. Focused lighting suitable for presentations and discussions. Used for short talks, briefings, and Q&A sessions.

nodes.name: presentation_screen
nodes.label: presentation screen
nodes.description: Large display screen used for slides, videos, and presentation content.

nodes.name: seating_area
nodes.label: seating area
nodes.description: Audience seating facing the presentation screen.

nodes.name: junction_1
nodes.label: junction 1
nodes.description: Main waypoint connecting entrance-side rooms to the rest of the lab.

nodes.name: living_room
nodes.label: living room
nodes.description: Visitor-facing lounge section of the HOME chamber, used for discussions, demonstrations, and short breaks during lab tours. Sofa seating faces the main demo and interaction direction. Tables and the large TV display are used to present projects and live demonstrations. Several mobile and legged robots are commonly showcased here, although their exact positions can change. Acts as an informal social hub for discussion and collaboration.

nodes.name: RBY1 robot
nodes.label: RBY1 robot
nodes.description: This is the Rainbow Robotics RB-Y1, a wheeled robot with a humanoid upper body and two arms. It's part of our humanoid robot display.

nodes.name: Unitree G1 robot
nodes.label: Unitree G1 robot
nodes.description: This is the Unitree G1, a compact humanoid robot. It's part of our humanoid robot display, and it also takes part in the WidowX kitchen demo.

nodes.name: Unitree Go1 quadruped
nodes.label: Unitree Go1 quadruped
nodes.description: This is our Unitree Go1, a four-legged robot dog.

nodes.name: junction_2
nodes.label: junction 2
nodes.description: Central navigation waypoint connecting the HOME area to the main laboratory corridor.

nodes.name: kitchen
nodes.label: kitchen
nodes.description: Kitchen section of the HOME chamber, used for refreshment and domestic-robotics demonstrations. Contains common kitchen appliances. Hosts robotics demonstrations involving object handover, food preparation, and interaction with domestic fixtures. Wooden cabinets provide storage for kitchen items and basic tools.

nodes.name: Data Collection Setup
nodes.label: Data Collection Setup
nodes.description: Our data collection setup collects data from the WidowX kitchen demo.

nodes.name: junction_3
nodes.label: junction 3
nodes.description: Central waypoint connecting the GHAF area, stairs, dexterous and production areas, and nearby robotics stations.

nodes.name: ghaf_chamber
nodes.label: ghaf chamber
nodes.description: GHAF underwater robotics and pool-testing area for aquatic autonomous systems. Used for controlled trials involving underwater navigation, sensing, and perception. Experiments focus on realistic marine-style scenarios using robots, obstacles, and mangrove features.

nodes.name: solar_panels
nodes.label: solar panels
nodes.description: Solar mockup area for cleaning solar panels demo. Used to explain energy management concepts in robotics systems.
